mapper.select: SELECT id, code, name, display_order FROM course_themes WHERE is_active = TRUE ORDER BY display_order, id

SELECT theme.id, theme.code, theme.name, mapping.course_id, mapping.display_order FROM course_theme_mappings mapping JOIN course_themes theme ON theme.id = mapping.theme_id WHERE theme.is_active = TRUE AND mapping.course_id IN #{courseId} ORDER BY mapping.course_id, mapping.display_order
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course_theme_mappings (course_id, theme_id, display_order) SELECT #{courseId}, id, #{displayOrder} FROM course_themes WHERE id = #{themeId} AND is_active = TRUE
